title: vnms
code:
LOD X // Load the control value
JMZ 7 // If X = 0, sum all ten numbers
SUB #1 // Check whether X = 1
JMZ 19 // If X = 1, sum the first five numbers
SUB #1 // Check whether X = 2
JMZ 26 // If X = 2, sum the last five numbers
HLT // For other values, stop without changing Z
LOD T1 // Start the total sum with T1
ADD T2 // Add the second number
ADD T3 // Add the third number
ADD T4 // Add the fourth number
ADD T5 // Add the fifth number
ADD T6 // Add the sixth number
ADD T7 // Add the seventh number
ADD T8 // Add the eighth number
ADD T9 // Add the ninth number
ADD T10 // Add the tenth number
STO Z // Save the total sum
HLT // Stop execution
LOD T1 // Start the first-half sum with T1
ADD T2 // Add the second number
ADD T3 // Add the third number
ADD T4 // Add the fourth number
ADD T5 // Add the fifth number
STO Z // Save the first-half sum
HLT // Stop execution
LOD T6 // Start the second-half sum with T6
ADD T7 // Add the seventh number
ADD T8 // Add the eighth number
ADD T9 // Add the ninth number
ADD T10 // Add the tenth number
STO Z // Save the second-half sum
HLT // Stop execution
